title: Armstrong Numbers
problemStatement: Check if n is an Armstrong number: sum of each digit raised to the number-of-digits power equals n.
intuition: First count digits (order), then peel digits and accumulate dig^order.

approaches.title: Count digits then power-sum
approaches.idea: Two passes over digits (or one count + one sum).
approaches.code:
def is_armstrong(n: int) -> bool:
    if n < 0:
        return False
    original = n
    order = len(str(n)) if n > 0 else 1
    total = 0
    x = n
    while x:
        dig = x % 10
        total += dig ** order
        x //= 10
    return total == original

commonMistakes: Integer overflow on pow in C++
followUps: Generate all Armstrong numbers with d digits?
interviewInsight: Tiny problem — they watch whether you generalize beyond the 3-digit example.
